songs.title: We'll Be Alright
songs.stylePrompt: warm melodic pop, ii-V-I progression, call and response into the chorus, textured mood
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse 1]
I open the window before the kettle calls
Cold air steps neatly through the hall
The cup in my hand has no answer
The street I knew by every stone
Has turned its collar red and gold
As if the map came home older
Loose leaves circle along the curb
My breath draws silver on the air
The morning waits without hurry
Beside my open door
[Chorus]
Leaves gather at the garden wall
We'll Be Alright
The postman nods, the rooftops shine
And I stand still enough to smile
[Verse 2]
A folded letter waits inside
Unsent, but kinder than regret
I read your name across the paper
The season sits beside my chair
Soft as a coat across my knees
And lets the old room widen
[Chorus]
The cold has manners after all
We'll Be Alright
It paints the gate, then lets me pass
With color resting in my hands
[Final Chorus]
We'll Be Alright
The minor road has found its morning
Every branch turns up to sing
We'll Be Alright
